items.summary: The authoritative snapshot reports pervypotion.com analytics as unconfigured, so traffic, conversions, revenue attribution, audience behavior, and operational health are unknown. Produce a bounded, site-specific assessment using available registry evidence and bounded public or repository evidence, documenting observable audience positioning, content coverage, conversion paths, monetization readiness, explicit unknowns, and one reversible next-step recommendation without inventing telemetry.
